teaser: Arsenal's defence printed points, United got dismantled at home, and City lost at Villa Park. Gameweek 8 rewarded anyone who went heavy on clean sheets.
fullWriteup:
**Manchester United 0-3 Bournemouth** was the headline, and it wasn't close. Villa beat City **2-1**, Chelsea were beaten **0-2** at home by Spurs, and Arsenal saw off Everton **2-0**. Newcastle won **0-2** at Palace, Liverpool handled Brighton **2-0**, and Fulham nicked it at Coventry. Sunderland and Leeds played out a goalless one, with draws at Ipswich and Hull too.

**Gabriel** was the standout with **17 points**, backed up by **Konsa** on **14** and White on 10 - an Arsenal back line that effectively won gameweeks on its own. **N.Jackson** took **13 points** out of the City win. Bournemouth's rout handed Hill 11, Truffert 10 and Rayan 10, while Bobb, Dedić and Tel all chipped in 11.

Price-wise, the Arsenal wave continues: Raya and Rice both up **£0.1m**, Konsa up to £4.7m. N.Jackson rose after his haul, and Bournemouth's Tavernier and Evanilson both ticked up off the back of Old Trafford. Going the other way, Saka dropped to £9.5m, with Cash and Reece James also down a notch.
